newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish biker wounded in high street shooting.
newsitem.headline: Danish biker wounded in high street shooting.

text.p: A simmering Nordic biker war erupted afresh on Tuesday after gunmen wounded a member of a motorcycle gang in a street shooting.

Police in the provincial town of Aalborg said they had arrested three men connected to the rival Hell's Angels gang on suspicion of the shooting, after a tipoff led them to retrieve an automatic weapon from a partly burnt-out car.
They said that the 26-year-old victim, who belonged to the Bandidos gang, was shot in the lower part of the body but added that his life was not in danger.

A battle for territory between the two gangs has killed six people and wounded several others since early 1994, as bikers battled each other with bombs, bullets and missiles across Denmark, Finland, Norway and Sweden.
Six Hell's Angels and their and associates are on trial for the March killing of Danish Bandidos President Uffe Larsen in a shootout at Copenhagen airport which also wounded three of his companions.
